notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
description:
Sacrifice Walking Ballista to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Endless One from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Endless One for {1}.
Sacrifice Endless One to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Walking Ballista for {2}.
Repeat.
